page.title: Meeting notes
page.intro: Written notes of your Jitsi meetings: the ones you started and the ones from meetings you took part in. Every copy is also in Sources › Generated.
page.empty: No meeting notes yet. Start them in a Jitsi meeting with the Meeting notes button.
page.enabled: Show the Meeting notes button in Jitsi
page.stt_model: Model name for the speech-to-text server (whisper.cpp ignores it; vLLM and cloud services need it)
page.stt_api_key: API key for the speech-to-text server (set on the command line or the API)
page.error: Could not load the meeting notes. Reload the page.
page.captions: Live captions in the meeting while notes are on
page.share: Give every signed-in participant a copy in their Sources › Generated (off: only the person who started gets it)

jitsi.consent: Everyone in this meeting will see that notes are on, and everyone signed in gets them in Synaplan Sources › Generated. Speech becomes text on your organisation's servers; audio is not kept.
jitsi.consent_own: Everyone in this meeting will see that notes are on; only you get them in Synaplan Sources › Generated. Speech becomes text on your organisation's servers; audio is not kept.
jitsi.sign_in: Sign in to use meeting notes
jitsi.saved: Notes saved in Synaplan Sources › Generated ({folder}).
jitsi.saved_all: Notes saved in Synaplan Sources › Generated ({folder}) for everyone who was signed in: {count} people.
jitsi.saved_partial: {count} participants did not get a copy. Ask your administrator.
jitsi.received: The meeting notes {name} started are in your Synaplan Sources › Generated ({folder}).
jitsi.nothing: Notes stopped. Nobody spoke, so no file was written.
jitsi.failed: Meeting notes stopped: {reason} Nothing more is being written down.
jitsi.stop_hint: Only {name} or an administrator can stop the notes here. A moderator can stop them with Jitsi's own control.
jitsi.err_already_running: Meeting notes are already on in this meeting.
jitsi.err_not_enabled: An administrator has turned meeting notes off.
jitsi.err_not_configured: Meeting notes are not fully set up yet. Ask your administrator.
jitsi.err_jitsi_unreachable: Jitsi did not answer. Notes were not started. Try again in a minute.
jitsi.err_room_not_found: This meeting is not running on the server yet. Wait a moment and try again.
jitsi.err_transcriber_not_connected: the transcription service did not connect.
jitsi.err_start_timeout: the start did not finish in time.
jitsi.err_file_not_saved: the transcript could not be saved in Synaplan. Ask your administrator.
jitsi.err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a minute.
